lines: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，
好叫我们得着智慧的心。
So give us knowledge of the number of our days
that we may get a heart of wisdom.
因为神的恩赐和选召是没有后悔的。
Because God's selection and his mercies may not be changed.
不要效法这个世界，
只要心意更新而变化，
叫你们察验何为神的善良、纯全、可喜悦的旨意。
And let not your behaviour be like that of this world
but be changed and made new in mind
so that by experience you may have knowledge of the good and pleasing and complete purpose of God.
按我们所得的恩赐，
各有不同。或说预言，
就当照着信心的程度说预言，
And having different qualities by reason of the grace given to us
such as the quality of a prophet
let it be made use of in relation to the measure of our faith;
按我们所得的恩赐，各有不同。或说预言，就当照着信心的程度说预言，
或作执事，就当专一执事；或作教导的，就当专一教导；
或作劝化的，就当专一劝化；施舍的，就当诚实；治理的，就当殷勤；怜悯人的，就当甘心。
And having different qualities by reason of the grace given to us, such as the quality of a prophet, let it be made use of in relation to the measure of our faith;
Or the position of a Deacon of the church, let a man give himself to it; or he who has the power of teaching, let him make use of it;

He who has the power of comforting, let him do so; he who gives, let him give freely; he who has the power of ruling, let him do it with a serious mind; he who has mercy on others, let it be with joy.
他必照各人的行为报应各人。
凡恒心行善、寻求荣耀、尊贵和不能朽坏之福的，就以永生报应他们；
惟有结党、不顺从真理、反顺从不义的，就以忿怒、恼恨报应他们。
Who will give to every man his right reward:
To those who go on with good works in the hope of glory and honour and salvation from death, he will give eternal life:
But to those who, from a love of competition, are not guided by what is true, will come the heat of his wrath,
不但如此，就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；
因为知道患难生忍耐，
And not only so
but let us have joy in our troubles: in the knowledge that trouble gives us the power of waiting;
不但如此，就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，
忍耐生老练，老练生盼望；
And not only so, but let us have joy in our troubles: in the knowledge that trouble gives us the power of waiting;
And waiting gives experience; and experience, hope:
我也知道在我里头，
就是我肉体之中，
没有良善。因为，
立志为善由得我，
只是行出来由不得我。
For I am conscious that in me
that is
in my flesh
there is nothing good: I have the mind but not the power to do what is right.
这样，我们可说甚么呢？律法是罪么？断乎不是！只是非因律法，
我就不知何为罪。非律法说「不可起贪心」，
我就不知何为贪心。
What then is to be said? is the law sin? in no way. But I would not have had knowledge of sin but for the law: for I would not have been conscious of desire if the law had not said
You may not have a desire for what is another's.
我们知道一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，
直到如今。
For we are conscious that all living things are weeping and sorrowing in pain together till now.
我们晓得万事都互相效力，
叫爱神的人得益处，
就是按他旨意被召的人。
And we are conscious that all things are working together for good to those who have love for God
and have been marked out by his purpose.
既是这样，还有甚么说的呢？神若帮助我们，
谁能敌挡我们呢？
What may we say about these things? If God is for us
who is against us?
谨守，贞洁，料理家务，
待人有恩，顺服自己的丈夫，
免得神的道理被毁谤。
To be wise in mind
clean in heart
kind; working in their houses
living under the authority of their husbands; so that no evil may be said of the word of God.
你自己凡事要显出善行的榜样，
在教训上要正直、端庄，
In all things see that you are an example of good works; holy in your teaching
serious in behaviour
